list_workspaces.title: List workspaces
list_workspaces.description: Every workspace in the account, with its region, status and the network and storage configurations behind it. The workspace id here is what the metastore-assignment and permission tools take.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_workspace.title: Get a workspace
get_workspace.description: One workspace's configuration and provisioning status. Worth polling after create_workspace -- provisioning is asynchronous and a workspace is not usable until its status settles on RUNNING.

output.description: The requested record.

create_workspace.title: Create a workspace
create_workspace.description: Provision a new workspace from credential, storage and network configurations that already exist. Provisioning is asynchronous and spends real cloud resources in your own account; poll get_workspace until the status settles.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_workspace.title: Update a workspace
update_workspace.description: Change a workspace's configuration -- its credentials, storage, network or managed keys. Some of these changes restart the workspace's compute plane, so they are not transparent to whoever is using it.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_workspace.title: Delete a workspace
delete_workspace.description: Delete a workspace. Notebooks, jobs, clusters and configuration go with it; data in your own cloud storage stays but becomes unreachable through Databricks. There is no undo.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_credentials.title: List credential configurations
list_credentials.description: The cross-account credential configurations workspaces are created from -- the IAM roles Databricks assumes in your cloud account.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_credential.title: Get a credential configuration
get_credential.description: One credential configuration, including the role ARN and external id Databricks uses to assume it.

output.description: The requested record.

create_credential.title: Create a credential configuration
create_credential.description: Register a cross-account IAM role Databricks may assume. The role has to trust Databricks' account and external id first, or workspace creation fails later rather than here.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

delete_credential.title: Delete a credential configuration
delete_credential.description: Delete a credential configuration. A workspace still using it breaks, so check list_workspaces first.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_storage_configurations.title: List storage configurations
list_storage_configurations.description: The root storage buckets workspaces are created against, where notebook results and system data live.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_storage_configuration.title: Get a storage configuration
get_storage_configuration.description: One storage configuration, with the bucket it points at.

output.description: The requested record.

create_storage_configuration.title: Create a storage configuration
create_storage_configuration.description: Register a cloud storage bucket as a workspace's root storage. The bucket policy must already allow Databricks, and the choice is effectively permanent for any workspace created against it.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

delete_storage_configuration.title: Delete a storage configuration
delete_storage_configuration.description: Delete a storage configuration. Any workspace using it loses its root storage, so this is only safe once no workspace references it.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_networks.title: List network configurations
list_networks.description: The customer-managed VPC configurations workspaces can be deployed into, each with its subnets and security groups.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_network.title: Get a network configuration
get_network.description: One network configuration, with its VPC, subnets, security groups and any validation errors Databricks found.

output.description: The requested record.

create_network.title: Create a network configuration
create_network.description: Register a customer-managed VPC for workspace deployment. Databricks validates the subnets and security groups here, so a configuration that saves cleanly is one a workspace can actually use.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

delete_network.title: Delete a network configuration
delete_network.description: Delete a network configuration. A workspace deployed into it is unaffected immediately but cannot be re-provisioned afterwards.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_private_access_settings.title: List private access settings
list_private_access_settings.description: The private access settings objects, which control whether a workspace is reachable over the public internet or only through PrivateLink.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_private_access_settings.title: Get private access settings
get_private_access_settings.description: One private access settings object, including its public access flag and allowed VPC endpoints.

output.description: The requested record.

create_private_access_settings.title: Create private access settings
create_private_access_settings.description: Create a private access settings object. Turning public access off is what makes a workspace PrivateLink-only -- and locks out anyone not on the private network, including you.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

replace_private_access_settings.title: Replace private access settings
replace_private_access_settings.description: Replace a private access settings object. A PUT, so an omitted field is reset -- and since this governs public reachability, a partial payload can silently expose or lock out a workspace.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_private_access_settings.title: Delete private access settings
delete_private_access_settings.description: Delete a private access settings object. Workspaces referencing it lose that network restriction.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_vpc_endpoints.title: List VPC endpoints
list_vpc_endpoints.description: The registered VPC endpoints used for PrivateLink connectivity to Databricks.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_vpc_endpoint.title: Get a VPC endpoint
get_vpc_endpoint.description: One registered VPC endpoint and its connection state.

output.description: The requested record.

create_vpc_endpoint.title: Register a VPC endpoint
create_vpc_endpoint.description: Register a VPC endpoint so PrivateLink traffic from it is accepted. The endpoint must already exist in your cloud account.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

delete_vpc_endpoint.title: Delete a VPC endpoint
delete_vpc_endpoint.description: Deregister a VPC endpoint. PrivateLink connectivity through it stops, which can cut a workspace off entirely if it was the only route.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_customer_managed_keys.title: List customer-managed keys
list_customer_managed_keys.description: The customer-managed encryption keys registered for workspace storage and managed services.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_customer_managed_key.title: Get a customer-managed key
get_customer_managed_key.description: One registered customer-managed key, with the use cases it covers.

output.description: The requested record.

create_customer_managed_key.title: Register a customer-managed key
create_customer_managed_key.description: Register a KMS key for encrypting workspace storage or managed services. Revoking the key in your cloud account later makes the data it protects unreadable -- by design.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

delete_customer_managed_key.title: Delete a customer-managed key
delete_customer_managed_key.description: Deregister a customer-managed key. Data already encrypted with it stays encrypted, so removing the registration while a workspace depends on it breaks that workspace.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_metastores.title: List metastores
list_metastores.description: The Unity Catalog metastores in the account. A metastore is the top of the data namespace -- catalogs, schemas and tables hang off it -- and one is assigned per workspace per region.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_metastore.title: Get a metastore
get_metastore.description: One metastore, with its root storage location and default data access configuration.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

output.description: The requested record.

create_metastore.title: Create a metastore
create_metastore.description: Create a Unity Catalog metastore in a region. One per region per account is the usual model, and the root storage location it is created with cannot be changed afterwards.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_metastore.title: Update a metastore
update_metastore.description: Change a metastore's name, owner or default data access credential. Changing the owner moves administrative control of every catalog under it.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_metastore.title: Delete a metastore
delete_metastore.description: Delete a metastore. Every catalog, schema and table definition under it goes -- the underlying cloud storage survives, but the governance layer that made it queryable does not.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_metastore_workspaces.title: List a metastore's workspaces
list_metastore_workspaces.description: Which workspaces are assigned to one metastore. The join between the account's data namespace and the workspaces that can query it.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_workspace_metastore.title: Get a workspace's metastore assignment
get_workspace_metastore.description: Which metastore a workspace is assigned to, and with which default catalog.

output.description: The requested record.

assign_workspace_metastore.title: Assign a metastore to a workspace
assign_workspace_metastore.description: Assign a metastore to a workspace, which is what makes Unity Catalog data visible there. A workspace has at most one metastore, so this replaces any existing assignment.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_workspace_metastore_assignment.title: Update a workspace's metastore assignment
update_workspace_metastore_assignment.description: Change a workspace's metastore assignment, typically its default catalog.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

unassign_workspace_metastore.title: Unassign a metastore from a workspace
unassign_workspace_metastore.description: Remove a workspace's metastore assignment. Every Unity Catalog table stops being queryable from that workspace immediately.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_metastore_storage_credentials.title: List a metastore's storage credentials
list_metastore_storage_credentials.description: The account-level storage credentials on a metastore -- the cloud identities Unity Catalog uses to reach data.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_metastore_storage_credential.title: Get a metastore storage credential
get_metastore_storage_credential.description: One account-level storage credential, with the cloud identity behind it.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

output.description: The requested record.

create_metastore_storage_credential.title: Create a metastore storage credential
create_metastore_storage_credential.description: Create an account-level storage credential on a metastore. It grants Unity Catalog access to cloud storage, so its scope decides what data the whole metastore can reach.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_metastore_storage_credential.title: Update a metastore storage credential
update_metastore_storage_credential.description: Change an account-level storage credential. Narrowing it can break external locations that depend on it.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_metastore_storage_credential.title: Delete a metastore storage credential
delete_metastore_storage_credential.description: Delete an account-level storage credential. Anything reading through it loses access at once.

metastore_id.description: The Unity Catalog metastore id, from list_metastores.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_account_users.title: List account users
list_account_users.description: The users in the account, over SCIM. Note this is account-level identity -- workspace access is granted separately with the permission-assignment tools.

filter.description: SCIM filter expression, e.g. userName eq "a@b.com".

attributes.description: Which attributes to return.

start_index.description: One-based index of the first result.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_account_user.title: Get an account user
get_account_user.description: One account user's SCIM record, including their entitlements and group memberships.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

output.description: The requested record.

create_account_user.title: Create an account user
create_account_user.description: Add a user to the account. They can then be assigned to workspaces; creating them here alone gives no workspace access.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_account_user.title: Replace an account user
update_account_user.description: Replace a user's SCIM record wholesale. Attributes omitted from the payload are cleared -- patch_account_user is the partial-update counterpart.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

patch_account_user.title: Patch an account user
patch_account_user.description: Apply SCIM patch operations to a user -- the safe way to change one attribute or entitlement without rewriting the record.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_account_user.title: Delete an account user
delete_account_user.description: Remove a user from the account. They lose access to every workspace at once, and anything running under their identity stops.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_account_groups.title: List account groups
list_account_groups.description: The account's SCIM groups, which is how entitlements and workspace access are granted to sets of people rather than individuals.

start_index.description: One-based index of the first result.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_account_group.title: Get an account group
get_account_group.description: One group's SCIM record, including its members and entitlements.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

output.description: The requested record.

create_account_group.title: Create an account group
create_account_group.description: Create an account group. Groups are the intended unit for granting workspace access and entitlements at scale.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_account_group.title: Replace an account group
update_account_group.description: Replace a group's SCIM record wholesale, including its member list. A partial member list silently removes everyone it omits.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

patch_account_group.title: Patch an account group
patch_account_group.description: Apply SCIM patch operations to a group -- how a member should normally be added or removed, since it does not rewrite the whole membership.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_account_group.title: Delete an account group
delete_account_group.description: Delete a group. Its members keep their accounts but lose everything the group granted them, which can cut off workspace access silently.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_account_service_principals.title: List account service principals
list_account_service_principals.description: The account's service principals -- the machine identities automation authenticates as.

start_index.description: One-based index of the first result.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_account_service_principal.title: Get an account service principal
get_account_service_principal.description: One service principal's SCIM record, with its application id and entitlements.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

output.description: The requested record.

create_account_service_principal.title: Create an account service principal
create_account_service_principal.description: Create a service principal for automation. It has no credentials until an OAuth secret is minted for it.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

patch_account_service_principal.title: Patch an account service principal
patch_account_service_principal.description: Apply SCIM patch operations to a service principal, for example to change its entitlements.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_account_service_principal.title: Delete an account service principal
delete_account_service_principal.description: Delete a service principal. Every job and integration authenticating as it stops working immediately.

id.description: The SCIM resource id -- the user, group or service principal id.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_workspace_permission_assignments.title: List a workspace's permission assignments
list_workspace_permission_assignments.description: Which account principals have access to one workspace, and at what level. This is the account-side view of workspace membership.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_workspace_assignable_permissions.title: List assignable workspace permissions
get_workspace_assignable_permissions.description: The permission levels that can be assigned on a workspace -- what update_workspace_permission_assignment will accept.

output.description: The requested record.

update_workspace_permission_assignment.title: Assign workspace permissions to a principal
update_workspace_permission_assignment.description: Grant a user, group or service principal access to a workspace at a given level. Assigning ADMIN gives them control of everything inside that workspace.

principal_id.description: The principal id -- a user, group or service principal.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_workspace_permission_assignment.title: Remove a principal's workspace access
delete_workspace_permission_assignment.description: Revoke a principal's access to a workspace. Anything they were running there stops on their next authentication.

principal_id.description: The principal id -- a user, group or service principal.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_service_principal_secrets.title: List a service principal's OAuth secrets
list_service_principal_secrets.description: The OAuth secrets minted for one service principal, with their creation and expiry. Secret values are never returned here -- only on creation.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_service_principal_secret.title: Create a service principal OAuth secret
create_service_principal_secret.description: Mint an OAuth client secret for a service principal. The secret value is returned once, on this call, and cannot be retrieved afterwards -- capture it here or it is lost.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

delete_service_principal_secret.title: Delete a service principal OAuth secret
delete_service_principal_secret.description: Revoke an OAuth secret. Anything authenticating with it fails immediately -- which is the point when rotating a leak.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_custom_app_integrations.title: List custom OAuth app integrations
list_custom_app_integrations.description: The custom OAuth applications registered on the account, each with its client id and redirect urls.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_custom_app_integration.title: Get a custom OAuth app integration
get_custom_app_integration.description: One custom OAuth app integration, with its scopes, redirect urls and token policy.

output.description: The requested record.

create_custom_app_integration.title: Create a custom OAuth app integration
create_custom_app_integration.description: Register a custom OAuth application. The client secret is returned once here; the scopes granted decide what any token minted through it can reach.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_custom_app_integration.title: Update a custom OAuth app integration
update_custom_app_integration.description: Change a custom OAuth app's redirect urls, scopes or token policy. Widening the scopes widens what every existing token can do.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_custom_app_integration.title: Delete a custom OAuth app integration
delete_custom_app_integration.description: Delete a custom OAuth app integration. Every application authenticating through it stops working.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_published_app_integrations.title: List published OAuth app integrations
list_published_app_integrations.description: The published (Databricks-provided) OAuth applications enabled on the account, such as the CLI and the Terraform provider.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_published_app_integration.title: Enable a published OAuth app integration
create_published_app_integration.description: Enable a Databricks-published OAuth application for the account, so its users can authenticate through it.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

delete_published_app_integration.title: Disable a published OAuth app integration
delete_published_app_integration.description: Disable a published OAuth application. Anyone signed in through it -- the CLI, for instance -- has to use another method.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_published_apps.title: List available published OAuth apps
list_published_apps.description: The Databricks-published OAuth applications that can be enabled on the account.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

list_federation_policies.title: List account federation policies
list_federation_policies.description: The workload identity federation policies on the account -- which external OIDC issuers may exchange a token for Databricks credentials.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_federation_policy.title: Get a federation policy
get_federation_policy.description: One federation policy, with the issuer and subject claims it trusts.

policy_id.description: The budget policy id, or the federation policy id on the federation tools.

output.description: The requested record.

create_federation_policy.title: Create a federation policy
create_federation_policy.description: Create a workload identity federation policy. Anything matching its issuer and subject claims can obtain Databricks credentials without a secret, so a loose subject pattern is a real exposure.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_federation_policy.title: Update a federation policy
update_federation_policy.description: Change a federation policy's issuer or claim matching. Widening the match widens who can authenticate as the account.

policy_id.description: The budget policy id, or the federation policy id on the federation tools.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_federation_policy.title: Delete a federation policy
delete_federation_policy.description: Delete a federation policy. Workloads relying on it -- typically CI -- stop being able to authenticate.

policy_id.description: The budget policy id, or the federation policy id on the federation tools.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_service_principal_federation_polici.title: List a service principal's federation policies
list_service_principal_federation_polici.description: Federation policies scoped to one service principal, rather than to the whole account.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_service_principal_federation_poli.title: Create a service principal federation policy
create_service_principal_federation_poli.description: Create a federation policy that lets an external workload authenticate as one specific service principal. Narrower than an account-wide policy and usually the right choice for CI.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

delete_service_principal_federation_poli.title: Delete a service principal federation policy
delete_service_principal_federation_poli.description: Delete a service-principal-scoped federation policy, so that workload can no longer authenticate.

policy_id.description: The budget policy id, or the federation policy id on the federation tools.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

download_usage.title: Download the usage CSV
download_usage.description: Download billable usage as CSV for a month range. The account-level cost record -- what the invoice is built from, at DBU granularity.

personal_data.description: Include user identity columns, which is personal data.

output.description: The requested record.

list_log_delivery_configurations.title: List log delivery configurations
list_log_delivery_configurations.description: The configurations that deliver billable usage and audit logs to your own cloud storage.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_log_delivery_configuration.title: Get a log delivery configuration
get_log_delivery_configuration.description: One log delivery configuration, with its output format, storage location and delivery status.

output.description: The requested record.

create_log_delivery_configuration.title: Create a log delivery configuration
create_log_delivery_configuration.description: Set up delivery of billable usage or audit logs to cloud storage. Audit log delivery is usually a compliance requirement, and it only covers events from creation onward -- history is not backfilled.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_log_delivery_status.title: Enable or disable log delivery
update_log_delivery_status.description: Enable or disable a log delivery configuration. Disabling audit log delivery creates a gap in the compliance record that cannot be filled in later.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_budgets.title: List budgets
list_budgets.description: The spend budgets configured on the account, with their thresholds and alert recipients.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_budget.title: Get a budget
get_budget.description: One budget, with its period, threshold and current consumption.

output.description: The requested record.

create_budget.title: Create a budget
create_budget.description: Create a spend budget with alert thresholds. Budgets notify -- they do not cap spend, so an alert is the only thing that happens when one is exceeded.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_budget.title: Update a budget
update_budget.description: Replace a budget's definition. A PUT, so an omitted field is cleared -- including, easily, its alert recipients.

attributes.description: The request payload, as the fields the provider's reference documents for this endpoint.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_budget.title: Delete a budget
delete_budget.description: Delete a budget. Spend continues; only the alerting stops, which is how an overrun goes unnoticed.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_budget_policies.title: List budget policies
list_budget_policies.description: Budget policies, which attribute serverless spend to a cost centre by tagging the workloads that run under them.
